hook: Li Fan is listed by Reuters Events as Chief Technology and AI Officer, Circle, among the speakers at Momentum AI Finance 2026 in New York. According to Li Fan's LinkedIn profile, chief AI officer at Circle since January 2025, and chief technology officer there from April 2021 to June 2026, so the profile dates the CTO role as ended.

quick_facts: Listed by Reuters Events as Chief Technology and AI Officer, Circle, among the speakers at Momentum AI Finance 2026 in New York

According to Li Fan's LinkedIn profile, chief AI officer at Circle since January 2025; chief technology officer at Circle from April 2021 to June 2026, the profile states, where Reuters Events lists the combined title

source_basis: Written from the Reuters Events speakers page for Momentum AI Finance 2026, New York, as the editor recorded it on 2026-10-20, and from Li Fan's LinkedIn profile, supplied to the editor as a PDF on 2026-10-20 (bridge row 1204). The profile is Li Fan's own account and has not been checked against other records.

editor_points.desc: According to Li Fan's LinkedIn profile: chief AI officer at Circle since January 2025; chief technology officer at Circle from April 2021 to June 2026; advisor and investor from 2020 to 2021; CTO and head of engineering at Lime from 2018 to 2020; SVP and head of engineering at Pinterest from 2016 to 2018; senior director of engineering at Google from 2014 to 2016, responsible for Google image search; at Baidu in Beijing, VP of engineering from 2012 to 2014 for web search and system infrastructure and executive director of engineering from 2010 to 2012; senior engineering manager at Google from 2002 to 2010 on search infrastructure including PageRank and crawl systems and the regional index for non-U.S. users; earlier a software engineer at Ingrian Networks and at Cisco, where the profile says he co-invented a method to detect non-responsive network flows in routers. MS in computer science, University of Wisconsin-Madison; BS in computer science, Fudan University. The profile is Li Fan's own account and has not been checked against other records.
editor_points.name: Career

editor_points.desc: According to Li Fan's LinkedIn profile, the career is search and infrastructure engineering at Google and Baidu and engineering leadership at Pinterest and Lime before Circle, where the profile gives chief AI officer from January 2025. Reuters Events lists the title as Chief Technology and AI Officer; the profile dates the CTO role as ended in June 2026. The profile is Li Fan's own account and has not been checked against other records.
